description: This file contains implementation of utility functions for managing CURL-based HTTP/HTTPS download operations, including initialization, stopping, pausing/resuming downloads, retrieving download progress, making PUT requests, and downloading files or data with optional authentication and security features.

methods.name: void * doCurlInit(void)
methods.description: Initializes CURL resources and returns a CURL handle.

methods.name: void doStopDownload(void * curl)
methods.description: Uninitializes CURL resources, freeing the CURL handle.

methods.name: int doInteruptDwnl(void * in_curl,unsigned int max_dwnl_speed)
methods.description: Pauses and resumes a download, optionally setting a download speed throttle.

methods.name: unsigned int doGetDwnlBytes(void * in_curl)
methods.description: Retrieves the number of bytes downloaded so far.

methods.name: int doCurlPutRequest(void * in_curl,FileDwnl_t * pfile_dwnl,char * jsonrpc_auth_token,int * out_httpCode)
methods.description: Performs a HTTP PUT request using CURL with specified data and headers.

methods.name: int getJsonRpcData(void * in_curl,FileDwnl_t * pfile_dwnl,char * jsonrpc_auth_token,int * out_httpCode)
methods.description: Performs a JSON RPC data download over HTTP/HTTPS.

methods.name: int doHttpFileDownload(void * in_curl,FileDwnl_t * pfile_dwnl,MtlsAuth_t * auth,unsigned int max_dwnl_speed,char * dnl_start_pos,int * out_httpCode)
methods.description: Downloads a file over HTTP/HTTPS, with support for authentication, speed throttling, and chunked download.

methods.name: int doAuthHttpFileDownload(void * in_curl,FileDwnl_t * pfile_dwnl,int * out_httpCode)
methods.description: Downloads a file over HTTP/HTTPS with authentication headers.
